author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This Claude Design tutorial walks you through building slides, documents, and your own brand kit in Claude Design, even if you have never opened a design tool before.
💵 Get 50% off QuickBooks Workforce for three months ➜ https://qbworkforce.kevinstratvert.com/

First, you will see where Claude Design lives inside Claude, which plans get access, and how it shares usage limits with chat, Cowork, and Claude Code.

Next, you will build a slide deck from a Word document you already have, so your dates, prices, and targets never get retyped or invented.

Then comes the move that matters most, which is picking a design system before you prompt instead of describing a look you do not have the words for.

Along the way, you will fix slides by saying what bothers you in plain language, with no design vocabulary needed.

Afterward, you will reskin a plain Word file in place and see the before and after side by side.
